/funplay-originals/khel-khud/shapestatic.description: Shapestatic is a climbing structure made of big geometric shapes. A blue sphere and a red cube cage are joined by rope nets, and children crawl through and climb over each shape to get from one end to the other. It is aimed at ages 5 to 12 and holds up to 15 children. The route through the shapes builds upper body strength, balance and pretend play, as children decide for themselves which way to go. The structure covers 25'5" x 14'5", and the safe play area is 31'5" x 18'5". It comes in a multi-colour scheme from our Khel-Khud collection. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope are covered for 3 years. Share your site plan and we will mark out where it fits.
/funplay-originals/khel-khud/shapestatic.spec_paragraph: Shapestatic is built from galvanised pipe frames with roto-moulded shapes and play rope nets linking them. We install it self-standing or grouted, depending on the soil. Since children move along its whole length, the 31'5" x 18'5" safe zone needs impact flooring end to end. Check the net joints where they meet each shape.
flags: No catalogue entry for Shapestatic, so the website age group and areas are unverified.
Only one image for this product.

/funplay-originals/khel-khud/sky-hop.htm.description: Sky Hop gives the old seesaw a new action. Instead of sitting and bumping, a child holds the bars, pulls with their body weight and hops upward off the stepping pads. The frame is crane-shaped and finished in Mineral with Sand Beige. It suits ages 5 to 12 and is slim, with a product area of 11'3" x 2' and a safe play area of 17'3" x 6'. That narrow footprint lets it sit along a path or between larger play pieces. Hopping, hanging and jumping work on upper body strength, coordination, balance and body awareness. The structure carries a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts. Call us on +91 902 830 2266 and we will check whether it suits your age group.
/funplay-originals/khel-khud/sky-hop.htm.spec_paragraph: Sky Hop is fixed self-standing or grouted, and because children push off hard, the base must be set firmly before use. Keep the 17'3" x 6' zone clear at both ends and lay rubber flooring beneath the stepping pads. Moving parts such as bearings carry a 1-year warranty, so include them in routine checks.
flags: Capacity '15' is implausible for a two-ended hopping post; left out of the copy.
Image description calls it 'wooden'; material not in the warranty line. Copy avoids calling it wooden.
Only one image for this product.

/funplay-originals/khel-khud/toddlers-tw.description: Toddlers Twist is a play cube for the youngest group in a playground, ages 3 to 8. Inside one pink and green frame there is a green slide, a swing and red climbing bars, so small children can try three kinds of play without leaving the cube. The scale is kept low and the challenges are gentle. Its product area is 17'3" x 12'11", the safe play area is 22'3" x 17'11", and it takes up to 15 children. Climbing, sliding and swinging build balance and upper body strength in early years. Preschools, day-care centres and the toddler corner of a society park are the usual buyers. It carries a 3-year warranty on its main materials. Ask us for a layout drawing.
/funplay-originals/khel-khud/toddlers-tw.spec_paragraph: Toddlers Twist uses galvanised pipe for the cube frame and roto-moulded parts for the slide and panels. It is installed self-standing or grouted. With toddlers on it, a soft surface across the whole 22'3" x 17'11" zone matters, as one installation shows on a pink safety surface. Check the swing fittings and bar grips often.

/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/archies.description: Archies is a compact wooden arch tower from our Nature Sparsh collection, made for two kinds of play at once. A yellow tube slide leaves from one side and a blue open slide from the other, and children climb up by a wooden climbing wall or a ladder. One child can climb while another slides, which keeps a queue moving. The tower suits ages 5 to 12 and takes up to 15 children. It comes in Banana Yellow and Baby Blue. The product area is 24'9" x 7'5", with a safe play area of 30'9" x 10'5", so it sits neatly along a narrow lawn. Our 3-year warranty covers its galvanised pipes, roto-moulded slides, composite laminates and play rope. Send us the width of your site.
/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/archies.spec_paragraph: Archies is a slim structure, only 7'5" deep, so it suits gardens where width is limited. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Leave the slide exits at both ends of the 30'9" x 10'5" safe zone clear, and lay impact flooring under each one. Check the wooden wall holds and ladder rungs on a regular schedule.
flags: Only one skill listed ('Simultaneous Play').

/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/aviral..description: Aviral is a multi play station in Banana Yellow with a minimal, open design. Its standout feature is an overhead hopscotch ladder, and the photos show it standing on a yellow hopscotch-pattern safety surface. Children climb spring climbers, cross an overhead net bridge and come down by a tube slide or an open slide. The station is open to ages 3 to 12, so younger siblings can play alongside older children. It takes up to 15 children, covers 27'5" x 21'9" and needs a safe play area of 32'5" x 26'9". Sliding, climbing and hopping build coordination, cooperative play, creativity and confidence with height. The pipes, moulded parts, laminates and rope carry a 3-year warranty. Ask us for a quote for your park or society.
/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/aviral..spec_paragraph: Aviral is among the larger Nature Sparsh stations, so plan for the full 32'5" x 26'9" zone before choosing a spot. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. The spring climbers should be checked for wear, since springs carry a 1-year warranty. Inspect the net bridge and both slides as part of routine maintenance.
flags: Image mentions 'spring climbers' but the warranty line does not list springs. Confirm.

/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/barrel-.description: Barrel Barrel is a play tower in the shape of a wooden barrel, with a Baby Blue wavy slide and a cage on top. Children climb in through an arch opening, up a rope net inside the barrel and out onto the top, then slide down. Blue climbing holds on the outside give a second way up. Parents can join in at the base, and the design invites play between children and adults. It suits ages 5 to 12. The tower is small, with a product area of 13'7" x 5'4" and a safe play area of 19'2" x 10'4". It builds arm strength, coordination and interactive play. Up to 15 children can use it at once, and the main structure carries a 3-year warranty. Tell us your corner size for a fit check.
/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/barrel-.spec_paragraph: Barrel Barrel combines a galvanised pipe frame, composite panels and an internal play rope net. Installation is self-standing or grouted. The inside of the barrel should be checked during cleaning for leaves and water, especially after the monsoon. Keep impact flooring at the slide exit and around the climbing holds.
flags: Dimensions (1740 x 824 cm) contradict the product area 13'7" x 5'4" (about 414 x 163 cm). Same placeholder values as Paper Mouse and Inframe.

/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/card-co.description: Card Cook is a card-themed play station in Sea Green and blue, built from folded panels with cut-outs. A red slide, an arched net climber, a rope net tunnel and a curved ladder are packed into one frame. It is designed for younger children, ages 3 to 9, and the cut-out panels give them windows to peep through as they move round. Activities cover climbing, sliding, hanging, balancing and crawling, which build coordination and gross motor skills. It takes up to 15 children. The product area is 13'5" x 11'8" and the safe play area is 17'11" x 16'8". The galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope have a 3-year warranty. Ask us for a layout drawing for your nursery or society park.
/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/card-co.spec_paragraph: Card Cook stands on galvanised pipe with composite card panels and a play rope tunnel and net. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Photos show it on blue and orange circular safety surfaces, and some form of impact flooring is needed across the 17'11" x 16'8" zone. Check the net tunnel and panel edges at each service.
flags: Product area 13'5" x 11'8" and safe area 17'11" x 16'8" are identical to the Ulta Ghar website values (already flagged against the catalogue). Possible copy-paste; no catalogue entry to confirm.
Current website copy mentions a 'folded plane', which does not match the card theme in the images.

/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/card-py.description: Card Pyramid builds a house of playing cards at child scale. The triangular A-frame tower is Banana Yellow and red, with rope nets, a climbing wall and wavy holds on its faces. Children climb up one side, work out a route over the top and come down the other, which builds problem solving, strategy and body strength. There is sliding as well as climbing. The tower is narrow, with a product area of 12'7" x 3'11" and a safe play area of 17'7" x 8'11", and it takes up to 15 children aged 5 to 12. That slim shape lets a school fit it along a corridor of open ground. Its pipes, laminates and rope carry our 3-year warranty. Send us photos of the space.
/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/card-py.spec_paragraph: Card Pyramid's A-frame is galvanised pipe with composite card faces and play rope nets. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Children may fall from either sloping face, so the 17'7" x 8'11" zone needs impact flooring on both long sides. One installation uses a round purple surface. Check the holds and net fixings regularly.
flags: Capacity '15' looks high for a 3'11" deep A-frame; kept as given, please confirm.

/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/fun.htm.description: Fun is a Nature Sparsh play frame built on wooden posts, with a red slide, monkey bars, overhead rings and coloured climbers. Children climb in, swing along the bars and rings and slide out, so the frame gives a full circuit in a small area. It is made for ages 5 to 12 and takes up to 15 children. The product area is 16'6" x 13'5". Climbing, hanging, sliding and balancing build body strength, and the open layout leaves room for children to invent their own games. It comes in Cherry Red. We give a 3-year warranty on the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us to mark the safe zone for your site on a layout drawing.
/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/fun.htm.spec_paragraph: Fun combines wooden-look posts with a galvanised pipe frame and a roto-moulded slide. It is set self-standing or grouted. Children hang from the monkey bars and rings, so lay impact flooring under the whole overhead section as well as at the slide exit. Check the ring fixings and bar grips regularly.
flags: Safe play area '21'6" x 18'18"' is invalid (18 inches); same in the catalogue. Left out of the copy. Confirm the correct figure.
Fugadi has exactly the same product area, safe area and dimensions as Fun, which suggests one was copied.

/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/inframe.description: Inframe is a tilted cube frame that invites children to picture themselves inside a picture frame and then find a way out. The structure is Lemon Yellow with navy, and it carries a tube slide, rope nets, a spiral climber and a geoboard where children can make shapes. It suits ages 5 to 12, takes up to 15 children, and needs a safe play area of 21'9" x 19'3" for a product area of 16'3" x 14'9". The mix of climbing, sliding and shape-making builds hand-eye coordination, arm strength, imagination and thinking skills. As part of our Nature Sparsh range it carries a 3-year warranty on its main materials. Write to sales@funplaysystems.com with your site details.
/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/inframe.spec_paragraph: The tilted cube is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded and composite parts and play rope nets. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Because the frame leans, check the safe zone on the low side carefully on our layout drawing. Inspect the geoboard ropes and the slide joints during regular maintenance.
flags: Dimensions (1740 x 824 x 800 cm) are placeholder values that contradict the product area 16'3" x 14'9". Same values on Paper Mouse and Barrel Barrel.
Product and safe areas are identical to Bellatrix (16'3" x 14'9", 21'9" x 19'3"); catalogue agrees, but please confirm.
Only one image for this product.

/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/phula.h.description: Phula is a long play station that children travel along from one end to the other. Wooden arch towers are linked by a tube tunnel, a curved stepping ladder and an arched net climber, and slides including a spiral tube slide bring them down. At 37'2" x 15'3", with a safe play area of 42'2" x 20'3", it is the longest piece in our Nature Sparsh collection and needs a large lawn or township park. It takes up to 15 children aged 5 to 12. Sliding, climbing and crawling build coordination, physical strength and creative exploration. The colours are Banana Yellow and Sand Beige. A 3-year warranty applies to its galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us for a site visit plan.
/funplay-originals/nature-sparsh/phula.h.spec_paragraph: Phula's towers are galvanised pipe with wooden-look and composite panels, joined by roto-moulded tunnels and rope nets. It is installed self-standing or grouted, and level ground along its length makes installation simpler. Mark the full 42'2" x 20'3" zone before planting trees or benches. Check the tunnel joints and stepping arch regularly.
flags: Capacity '15' looks low for the longest Nature Sparsh structure; kept as given, please confirm.

/funplay-originals/organic-play/cipu-sit.description: Cipu Sittu is a merry-go-round with a sea theme. Shark fins rise around the Sky Blue platform, so riders feel as if they are circling in deep water. In the photos a blue water-pattern surface completes the scene. It suits ages 5 to 12. The unit is compact at 5' x 5', with a safe play area of 8'8" x 8'8", so it slots into most society gardens and school play areas. Revolving together builds balance, coordination, imagination and cooperative play. It belongs to our Organic Play collection. The galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts are covered for 3 years, and the bearings for 1 year. Add it to your layout request and we will mark its spinning zone.
/funplay-originals/organic-play/cipu-sit.spec_paragraph: Cipu Sittu turns on a bearing, which carries a 1-year warranty, while the galvanised frame and roto-moulded fins are covered for 3 years. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Keep the 8'8" x 8'8" zone clear so no one stands in the path of the fins, and check the bearing for play at every service.
flags: Capacity '15' is implausible for a 5' x 5' merry-go-round; left out of the copy.
No catalogue entry. Only one image.

/funplay-originals/organic-play/ghogalo..description: Ghogalo is a snail with a quirky face and a wooden rolling barrel for a shell. Inside the barrel children can run and roll, and an orange spiral marks the shell from outside. Antenna-shaped net climbers stand at the head and a wavy balance trail runs along the body. Children aged 5 to 12 use it, up to 15 at a time. The snail is long and slim, 31'1" x 6'9", with a safe play area of 35'1" x 11'9". Climbing, crawling, rolling, sitting and balancing build arm strength, hand-eye coordination and imaginative play. It is offered in Mineral and Royal Turquoise. Our 3-year warranty covers the galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Call +91 902 830 2266 for a quote.
/funplay-originals/organic-play/ghogalo..spec_paragraph: Ghogalo's barrel roller turns on bearings, which carry a 1-year warranty, and should be checked for free movement at each service. The frame is galvanised pipe with composite and rope parts. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Keep the full 35'1" x 11'9" zone clear, with impact flooring under the climbers.
flags: Skill 'Cognitve Balance' misspelt in the fact sheet.

/funplay-originals/organic-play/hittu.ht.description: Hittu, also called the Pink Hen, is a bird-faced play tower with its wings spread as two Sea Green slides. Children climb up a rope net and the pink climbing frame behind the grey bird face, then slide down either wing. Two slides mean two children can come down together, which helps at busy times in a school break. It is designed for ages 5 to 12, takes up to 15 children, and covers 20'3" x 15'4", with a safe play area of 25'9" x 20'4". Play here builds imagination and gross motor skills. It is part of our Organic Play range. The 3-year warranty covers its pipe, moulded parts, laminates and rope. Ask us how Hittu fits your play area.
/funplay-originals/organic-play/hittu.ht.spec_paragraph: Hittu is built on galvanised pipe with roto-moulded slides and a play rope net, set self-standing or grouted as the ground needs. The two slides exit on opposite sides, so the 25'9" x 20'4" zone needs clear ground and impact flooring at both ends. Check the net and the bird face panel fixings regularly.
flags: Product area on the website is 20'3" x 15'4" but the catalogue gives 20'3" x 16'4". Copy uses the website value. Confirm with FunPlay.
Colour listed as Sea Green, while the current description calls it the Pink Hen and images show a pink frame.
